title: Control shadow AI
subtitle: Find unapproved tools, assess risk, govern useful ones, and repeat on a fixed cycle.

steps.title: Discover unapproved AI tools
steps.evidence: Review Entra ID enterprise applications, Copilot Studio and SharePoint agents, and licensed AI service members to find unapproved tools.

steps.title: Assess data reach and usage
steps.evidence: Assess each tool's data reach, users and autonomy

steps.title: Approve valuable tools
steps.evidence: approve valuable tools under inventory, ownership and access review

steps.title: Retire the rest and repeat
steps.evidence: or revoke consent and retire them. Repeat discovery on a fixed cycle.
